description: This source file pertains to the implementation of the DSA (Distributed Switch Architecture) driver for Realtek RTL83xx switch chips within the Linux kernel. It includes management of switch initialization, VLAN setup, port control, MIB (Management Information Base) counters, link status, and other switch-specific functions.

methods.name: enum:dsa_tag_protocol rtldsa_get_tag_protocol(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,enum dsa_tag_protocol mprot)
methods.description: Returns the DSA tag protocol used by the switch; indicates that the switch internally tags packets with header structures instead of external tags.

methods.name: rtldsa_vlan_set_pvid
methods.description: Sets the inner and outer PVIDs (Port VLAN ID) for a given switch port, used for VLAN tagging and filtering.

methods.name: rtldsa_vlan_setup
methods.description: Initializes VLAN configuration, including default VLANs and PVIDs, and sets up VLAN forwarding and filtering rules.

methods.name: rtldsa_setup_bpdu_traps
methods.description: Configures traps for BPDUs (Bridge Protocol Data Units) to be sent to the CPU for processing.

methods.name: rtldsa_setup_lldp_traps
methods.description: Configures traps for LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol) frames to be sent to the CPU.

methods.name: rtldsa_port_set_salrn
methods.description: Enables or disables the SALRN (Source Address Learning and Renewal Notification) feature on a port.

methods.name: int rtldsa_83xx_setup(struct dsa_switch * ds)
methods.description: Main setup function for RTL83xx series in standalone mode, configuring ports, VLANs, MAC polling, and statistics.

methods.name: int rtldsa_93xx_setup(struct dsa_switch * ds)
methods.description: Main setup routine for RTL93xx series in switch mode, configuring PHY, VLAN, MAC, and other features.

methods.name: struct:phylink_pcs * rtldsa_phylink_mac_select_pcs(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,phy_interface_t interface)
methods.description: Selects the PHY interface (Physical Coding Sublayer) for a port, returning the PCS instance.

methods.name: void rtldsa_83xx_phylink_get_caps(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct phylink_config * config)
methods.description: Provides supported MAC capabilities for RTL83xx ports, such as pause frames and speed modes.

methods.name: void rtldsa_93xx_phylink_get_caps(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct phylink_config * config)
methods.description: Provides supported PHY link modes for RTL93xx ports, including higher speeds like 10G.

methods.name: void rtldsa_83xx_phylink_mac_config(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,const struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Configures the MAC for a port, typically used for enabling autonegotiation or setting MAC mode.

methods.name: void rtldsa_931x_phylink_mac_config(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,const struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Specialized configuration for RTL931x PHY MAC, mostly resetting the MAC force settings.

methods.name: void rtldsa_93xx_phylink_mac_config(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,const struct phylink_link_state * state)
methods.description: Configures the port MAC settings for RTL93xx, including speed, duplex, and flow control.

methods.name: void rtldsa_83xx_phylink_mac_link_down(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,phy_interface_t interface)
methods.description: Handles link-down event for RTL83xx, stopping TX/RX and clearing link force.

methods.name: void rtldsa_93xx_phylink_mac_link_down(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,phy_interface_t interface)
methods.description: Same as above, for RTL93xx, stopping traffic and clearing link force.

methods.name: void rtldsa_83xx_phylink_mac_link_up(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,phy_interface_t interface,struct phy_device * phydev,int speed,int duplex,bool tx_pause,bool rx_pause)
methods.description: Handles link-up event, configuring MAC for speed, duplex, pause frames, and restarting TX/RX.

methods.name: void rtldsa_93xx_phylink_mac_link_up(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,unsigned int mode,phy_interface_t interface,struct phy_device * phydev,int speed,int duplex,bool tx_pause,bool rx_pause)
methods.description: Handles link-up with support for higher speeds, configuring MAC accordingly.

methods.name: const struct rtldsa_mib_desc * rtldsa_get_mib_desc(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv)
methods.description: Returns the MIB (Management Information Base) descriptor tailored to the switch family.

methods.name: rtldsa_read_mib_item
methods.description: Reads a specific MIB counter value for a port, handling different register regions and sizes.

methods.name: rtldsa_update_counter
methods.description: Updates a counter value based on latest hardware reading, handling overflow for 32-bit counters.

methods.name: rtldsa_update_link_stat
methods.description: Aggregates port counters to fill a standard link statistics structure.

methods.name: rtldsa_update_port_counters
methods.description: Reads and updates all relevant port counters for traffic monitoring.

methods.name: void rtldsa_get_stats64(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct rtnl_link_stats64 * s)
methods.description: Provides detailed network statistics for a port, suitable for ethtool.

methods.name: void rtldsa_get_eth_phy_stats(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct ethtool_eth_phy_stats * phy_stats)
methods.description: Retrieves Ethernet PHY-specific statistics, such as symbol errors.

methods.name: void rtldsa_get_eth_mac_stats(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct ethtool_eth_mac_stats * mac_stats)
methods.description: Provides MAC layer statistics, such as frame counts and collision counts.

methods.name: void rtldsa_get_rmon_stats(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct ethtool_rmon_stats * rmon_stats,const struct ethtool_rmon_hist_range ** ranges)
methods.description: Returns RMON (Remote Monitoring) statistics for port traffic analysis, including histograms.

methods.name: rtldsa_port_enable
methods.description: Enables a port, setting VLAN, traffic, and port forwarding parameters.

methods.name: void rtldsa_port_disable(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Disables a port, removing it from traffic forwarding.

methods.name: rtldsa_set_mac_eee
methods.description: Enables or disables Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) on a port.

methods.name: int rtldsa_get_mac_eee(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct ethtool_keee * eee)
methods.description: Queries EEE capability support on a port.

methods.name: rtldsa_set_ageing_time
methods.description: Sets the VLAN table ageing time parameter.

methods.name: void rtldsa_mst_init(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u16 mst_slot)
methods.description: Initializes MST (Multiple Spanning Tree) slots for VLAN segmentation.

methods.name: int rtldsa_mst_find(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u16 msti)
methods.description: Finds existing MST slot for a given MSTI (Multiple Spanning Tree Instance).

methods.name: int rtldsa_mst_get(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u16 msti)
methods.description: Allocates or gets a HW slot for an MSTI, managing reference counts.

methods.name: int rtldsa_mst_recycle_slot(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u16 msti,u16 old_mst_slot)
methods.description: Recycles an MST slot if it is no longer in use, to avoid running out of slots.

methods.name: bool rtldsa_mst_put_slot(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u16 mst_slot)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count on an MST slot, freeing it if no longer used.

methods.name: int rtldsa_mst_replace(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,u16 msti,u16 old_mst_slot)
methods.description: Replaces an old MST slot with a new one when changing MSTIs for VLANs.

methods.name: rtldsa_update_port_member
methods.description: Updates the port membership mask when a VLAN is joined or left, affecting forwarding.

methods.name: int rtldsa_port_bridge_join(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct dsa_bridge bridge,bool * tx_fwd_offload,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Handles the event of a port joining a VLAN bridge, updating port membership and states.

methods.name: void rtldsa_port_bridge_leave(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port,struct dsa_bridge bridge)
methods.description: Handles VLAN leave, updating port memberships and forwarding states.

methods.name: rtldsa_port_xstp_state_set
methods.description: Sets the port’s state in the spanning tree protocol (STP) for a specific MST.

methods.name: rtldsa_port_stp_state_set
methods.description: Sets the spanning tree state (blocking, listening, learning, forwarding) for a port.

methods.name: void rtldsa_83xx_fast_age(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Performs an immediate MAC address table flush (fast age) on an RTL83xx switch in standalone mode.

methods.name: void rtldsa_931x_fast_age(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Performs MAC table flush for RTL931x series switches, using a specific hardware command.

methods.name: void rtldsa_930x_fast_age(struct dsa_switch * ds,int port)
methods.description: Performs MAC table flush on RTL930x switches, calling the appropriate hardware command.

methods.name: rtldsa_port_mst_state_set
methods.description: Sets the spanning tree state in a specific MST instance for a port.

methods.name: rtldsa_vlan_filtering
methods.description: Enable or disable VLAN filtering for a port, affecting how VLAN-tagged frames are handled.

methods.name: rtldsa_vlan_prepare
methods.description: Prepares VLAN settings before adding or modifying VLAN configurations.

methods.name: rtldsa_vlan_add
methods.description: Adds VLAN configuration for a port, including port memberships and tagging.
